description: List point-in-time snapshots (local backups) for a local SQLite database, newest first. Snapshots are created with litescope_snapshot (requires --allow-writes). Use this to find a snapshot to restore, or to confirm a database has a backup before a risky write. Read-only; local files only.
name: litescope_snapshot_list

snapshots.description: Snapshots, newest first, with path, label, and timestamp.

source.description: The database the snapshots belong to.

title: List snapshots
